title: Merchants Capital to Acquire Remaining Interest in VIUM Capital, Expanding Its Seniors Housing and Healthcare Lending Platform
summary: Merchants Bancorp ("Merchants") (Nasdaq: MBIN) today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Merchants Capital Corp. ("MCC") has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the remaining ownership interest in VIUM Capital, LLC ("VIUM") that MCC does not currently own. VIUM is a leading healthcare and seniors housing lending platform. After closing, VIUM will become a division of MCC.
